# Vec2Sent
Probing Sentence Embeddings with Natural Language Generation
metadata.reason: Title of the README identifying the artifact name and subtitle description

metadata.evidence: [![arXiv](https://img.shields.io/badge/View%20on%20arXiv-B31B1B?logo=arxiv&labelColor=gray)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2011.00592)
metadata.reason: Direct link to the arXiv paper describing the artifact

metadata.value: We introspect black-box sentence embeddings by conditionally generating from them with the objective to retrieve the underlying discrete sentence. We perceive of this as a new unsupervised probing task and show that it correlates well with downstream task performance. We also illustrate how the language generated from different encoders differs. We apply our approach to generate sentence analogies from sentence embeddings.
